measurement_contract.aggregate_policy: equal-weight workload cells, separated by scale and route; compiler phases are diagnostic only
measurement_contract.memory: isolated process-tree RSS replay, never observer in timed region
measurement_contract.privacy: reports contain no host identity, absolute paths, commands, endpoints, secrets, or raw subprocess text
measurement_contract.sharding: deterministic family shards; merge disjoint complete cell identities
measurement_contract.statistics: paired geometric mean and 95% hierarchical percentile-bootstrap confidence interval; retain every sample

provenance.workload_lineage: clbg-* and llvm-* identifiers are historical style labels, not claims that official suite programs are included
